title: Last Argument of Kings
author: Joe Abercrombie
summary: Third and final volume of the First Law trilogy. War on several fronts closes in on a kingdom of schemers, soldiers and a torturer, as old secrets and long-laid plans finally come due.
readIf: you like bleak, darkly funny fantasy and want to see how a cynical story ends.
skipIf: you haven't read the first two books, since this concludes their plots.

pairings.reason: A comparable high point in another grim epic, where betrayals and battle change everything.
A newer grim fantasy about war that shares the sense that victory is expensive.
A cynical mercenary view of war and empire written with dry, weary humour.
